node.statement: The source B_R^{raw} is a genuine finite-dimensional C*-algebra, so its multiplication is associative; hence q_1+q_2=I gives x=(q_1+q_2)x(q_1+q_2)=sum_{i,j=1}^2 q_i x q_j for every x in B_R^{raw}. For each i,j, compose the supplied phi_{ij}:q_i B_R^{raw}q_j -> T_{ij} with the supplied inclusion T_{ij} -> A_R. Thus all four summands used in node 1.3.3.2 are A_R-valued. This typing uses multiplication only in the exact source B_R^{raw}; it neither forms nor identifies any space Q_i A_R Q_j and therefore assumes no associativity or corner identification in the extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra A_R.
